notes.title: アップデート配信のお知らせ（Ver.1.0.3）
notes.content:
We have released Ver. 1.0.3 with the following updates.

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where insufficient SteamCloud storage prevented saving photos when playing the game in 4K resolution.
[*] Improved gamepad functionality in the “Apparition Encyclopedia.”
[*] Improved gamepad functionality on the “Results” screen.
[*] Fixed an issue where the effects when the Fox Priestess retrieved her fan were not displayed correctly.
[*] Corrected errors in some entries of the “Apparition Encyclopedia” when the language was set to Italian.
[*] Fixed an issue where certain text was not formatted correctly when the language was set to Russian.
[*] Fixed an issue where some apparition names were not displayed in the “Apparition Encyclopedia” when the language was set to Traditional Chinese.
[*] Other minor bugs have been fixed.
[/list]
Thank you for your continued support of The Fox’s Way Home.

notes.content:

notes.title: Community Item Offering Begins!
notes.content:
We’ve prepared a variety of community items, including an exclusive illustration of the main character, the “Fox Shrine Maiden,” allowing you to immerse yourself even deeper in the world of The Fox’s Way Home!


[h3]・Badge (6 Type Available)[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45108578/394840600e53884dee3df826f8fc0e5b3b2beecf.png[/img]
▲ Example Badge
A new badge featuring a SD version of the Fox Shrine Maiden is now available! The design is a surprise—you’ll have to earn it to see it!


[h3]・Trading Cards (5 Types Available)[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45108578/849b4f3a0a013fec9162078c6877fa1c9c55be0c.png[/img]　[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45108578/74217cedd117e6f870926a70a899851bc2ceb86c.png[/img]
▲ Example Trading Card
The Fox Shrine Maiden makes her debut as a trading card! Collect and enjoy her adorable expressions from the game!

[h3]・Profile Backgrounds (3 Types Available)[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45108578/8b959898796d61d730a1818ed3534a4cbbf4eb57.png[/img]
▲ Example Profile Background
In addition to the key visual background from "The Fox’s Way Home", we’ve prepared an exclusive, elegantly designed profile background available only as a community item!


[h3]・Emoticon（5 Types Available）[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45108578/95774d9ec86a80ed32388861ce08821c465a33a2.png[/img] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45108578/c137c83148142057a7250435defe847e3fac9c52.png[/img]
▲ Example Emoticon
Items worn by the Fox Shrine Maiden are now available as unique emojis! Feel free to use these charming emojis in your profile and comments!


Be sure to grab these items and enjoy!

notes.title: Notification Update(Ver.1.0.1)
notes.content:
[b]Announcement[/b]
- We have released Ver.1.0.1, which includes the following updates and fixes.


[b]Update Details[/b]
[h3]Changed it so that the Success Animation will now display in the dialogue scene after successfully completing the Fox Shrine Maiden's ritual 8 times in a row.[/h3]

[b]Improving Camera Operations[/b]
- Changed the camera reset operation so it can now be performed with a right-click of the mouse.
- Adjusting the time it takes for the camera angle to reset after being changed during 
the Fox Shrine Maiden's ritual.

[b]Other[/b]
- Added an option in the settings menu to lock the input device.
 　Use this option if mouse and keyboard gameplay is unstable in certain environments where a gamepad 　is also connected.
　* This setting is generally unnecessary, as the appropriate device is automatically detected.
- Minor bug fixes and text error corrections


Thank you.
